note: The task specification behind all four doors. The metric names are what the owner asked this area to show - tokens per done, attempts, which template held (state/briefs/context-75.md) - and their numbers are fixture values, chosen so one pass meets a failed gate, an inconclusive gate and four passing ones. Nothing here measures this repository: what IS measured is what the pass then does with them, read back out of the iteration records into the learned table. The gate replays harness/evaluation's own registered corpus at two pinned versions of its release reviewer, so what each candidate is really put through is that corpus and not a corpus of this platform's runs; README section 6, gap G1.

metrics.means: spend per definition of done reached, as a share of the spend it takes today
attempts taken per definition of done reached, over a span of three attempts
share of runs of a named template that reach their done without a revision

candidates.rationale: fill the attempter slot from a cheaper model class and answer without reading the change
same slot, same saving, with the step that reads the change kept
escalate on the deciding check failing twice the same way, gated over the one case that shows it
fold the previous attempt's outcome into the next attempt's contract
put the visible checks inside the contract so a run that cannot pass them never reaches the gate
